description: Models a multi-year program of private-fund commitments (PE, VC, private credit and similar): capital calls, distributions, unrealized NAV, and the year with the worst net cash flow, using a simplified adaptation of the Takahashi-Alexander pacing framework. Contribution pace, distribution pace and fund life are inputs. Runs across several named forward-looking growth scenarios by default; set scenario to a single id for one result. Pass annual_liquidity_budget to flag the years a stated budget would be breached.

annual_commitment.description: Dollar amount committed to new private-fund vintages each year

annual_liquidity_budget.description: Optional — the client's actual annual liquidity budget for capital calls, to flag years it would be breached

fund_life_years.description: Assumed life of each fund vintage in years (default 12)

investment_period_years.description: Years each vintage actively calls capital before calls stop (default 5)

rate_of_contribution.description: Fraction of a vintage's uncalled capital called per year during its investment period (default 0.30)

rate_of_distribution.description: Base annual distribution rate applied to NAV, back-loaded via a bow curve (default 0.20)

scenario.description: A single market-assumptions.js scenario id (historical_baseline, regime_transition, ai_productivity_acceleration, structural_stagnation) to run one scenario only — omit to run the default set and see the range

vintage_years.description: How many consecutive years the client keeps making new commitments (default 5)

name: advisor.commitment_pacing_model
title: Illiquidity Stress-Test / Commitment-Pacing Model
